name: EuropeanSACTRegimenCatalog
title: European SACT Regimen Catalog — Executable Knowledge Layer for Systemic Anti-Cancer Therapy Regimens
description:
FHIR R4 Implementation Guide that represents systemic anti-cancer therapy
(SACT) regimens as executable knowledge artifacts (PlanDefinition,
ActivityDefinition, MedicationKnowledge, Library, CodeSystem, ConceptMap).
Catalog-layer companion to the HL7 Europe Cancer Common Model (PHOENIX) and
the German MII Onkologie module. First content source: the HemOnc Knowledge
Base (HemOncKB). Developed in cooperation with HL7 Europe PHOENIX, HemOnc.org,
OHDSI Oncology and MII Onkologie. CC BY 4.0.
